releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.6 — Pure Telegram Click Flow (No Click Pop-up), Inline Reactions & Clean Header
releaseNotes:
• Smooth Conversation Flow: Single click on message row now produces gentle ripple feedback and NEVER opens a pop-up. Context actions are reserved strictly for long-press.
• Inline Reactions Inside Bubble: Applied reaction badges now sit cleanly inside the message box container directly beneath the message content.
• Streamlined Action Menu: Removed duplicate 'Select' action (multi-selection handled via continuous tapping/long-press).
• Clean Username: Blue verified tick badge removed from user header.
• 120Hz Dynamic UI: Dynamic Island call pill, elastic swipe-to-reply, consecutive adaptive bubble morphing & kinetic photo lightbox.
